reference.authority: User-supplied visual reference; latest Main and Root clarification permits original reference/fixture item-art candidates before production catalog/media binding.
reference.coordinateSystem: Original 1280x853 JPEG, approximate manual full-image inspection, [left,top,right,bottom].

derivation.method: Original hand-authored editable SVG interpretation of the three approved visible item motifs, not a pixel extraction, tracing or photorealistic product representation.
derivation.lettering: Original geometric MCR and PARADE vector lettering, drawn as paths from reference-visible words; no font or copied logo paths.
derivation.rights: The photograph and branding remain their respective owners' material. These original generic vector motif candidates do not establish merchandise authenticity, permission to sell, inventory, ownership or trademark clearance.
derivation.reuse: Reference/fixture preview only until Root153 supplies approved identity/media mapping and the applicable production rights/provenance decision. Never a no-photo fallback.

placement.listConsumer: ReferenceGiftRow .gift-reference-image; current square, minmax(78px,29%) list track, 1px symmetric border, object-fit:contain.
placement.detailConsumer: GiftDetail has no image slot in the audited production source. No detail integration or qualified detail size is claimed.
placement.detailProposal: Keep the same square SVG source and contain fit if a detail image slot is later authorized. Up to 256 CSS pixels is a source specimen size only, not a product requirement.
